title: אוֹתִיּוֹת רָצוֹת · Letters That Run
built_by: Claude Code (claude-cli) on Iddo Perez's DGX fleet
source_of_content: D:/CLAUDE/otiyot-ratsot/OTIYOT-RATSOT.md (§2 the room, §3 a day, §6 the letters)

disclosure.burned_in_every_frame: PRODUCED BY AI · הופק על ידי בינה מלאכותית
disclosure.position: bottom of frame, over a soft gradient band, composited over the ENTIRE timeline in one ffmpeg pass including the head and tail cards
disclosure.head_card: THIS FILM WAS PRODUCED BY AI. No real children were filmed. Every person and place shown is generated.
disclosure.tail_card: PRODUCED BY AI · Every frame is synthetic. No real child, teacher, school or place is depicted.

people_policy: No real or identifiable person. Children appear as hands, backs, shoulders, feet, silhouettes and wide room shots; no lingering close-up of a face; no named place, no logo, no signage.

resolution_statement.delivered_frame_note: a 5% inset is cropped from each edge before the final 4K rescale — a safety net against LTX stamping invented station bugs into the extreme corners, since at cfg 1.0 there is no working negative prompt to forbid them
resolution_statement.path_to_4k: Real-ESRGAN x4plus (a real learned x4 upscaler, downloaded to ~/comfy/models/upscale_models on eran1 and eran2) -> 6144x3456, then bicubic+antialias cover-fit and centre-crop to exactly 3840x2160. This is a genuine learned upscale, NOT an ffmpeg lanczos stretch — but the true optical detail originates at 1536x864 and no claim is made that this is a natively-4K master.

hdr_statement: NOT HDR. LTX-13B and FLUX both output 8-bit SDR, and the whole chain here is 8-bit yuv420p BT.709. The file is an SDR master and is not labelled HDR. True HDR would need a graded 10-bit pipeline we do not have.

audio.score: render/score_almido.py — original, written for this film (slow D drone, five-note pentatonic motif, pad, room air). No copyrighted music anywhere in this file.

ffmpeg_chain.per_shot_4k_encode: ffmpeg -f rawvideo -pix_fmt rgb24 -s 3840x2160 -r 24 -i pipe:0 -an -c:v libx264 -preset medium -crf 16 -pix_fmt yuv420p <shot>.mp4
ffmpeg_chain.final_single_pass: ffmpeg -i head.mp4 -i <16 shot mp4s> -i tail.mp4 -i disclosure_strip.png -i score_almido.wav -filter_complex "[N:v]crop=iw*0.9:ih*0.9:iw*0.05:ih*0.05,scale=3840:2160:flags=lanczos,setsar=1,fps=24,format=yuv420p[cN]; ... concat=n=18:v=1:a=0[body];[body][strip:v]overlay=0:0:format=auto[v];[audio:a]atrim=0:<dur>,asetpts=N/SR/TB,afade=t=in:st=0:d=3,afade=t=out:st=<dur-5>:d=5,volume=0.8[a]" -map [v] -map [a] -c:v libx264 -preset slow -crf 17 -pix_fmt yuv420p -r 24 -c:a aac -b:a 192k -shortest -movflags +faststart ALMIDO-otiyot-ratsot-4K.mp4
ffmpeg_chain.why_one_pass: the concat FILTER is used rather than the concat demuxer so the crop, the rescale and the disclosure overlay all apply to the single joined stream — there is no branch that can emit an undisclosed frame

known_limitations: Neither LTX-13B nor FLUX.1-dev can render Hebrew script: prompted for a chalk aleph, FLUX produced a physical prop reading 'AH'. Every aleph in this film is therefore drawn from a real Hebrew font and composited into the plate before animation. This is recorded because it is the single most load-bearing fact about how the film was made.
LTX image-to-video drifts off the composited plate whenever the prompt implies camera movement — three shots (06, 10, 16) had to be re-rendered with a locked-off camera and 65 frames instead of 97.
12_honey is trimmed to 80 frames; LTX hallucinated text along the bottom edge in the tail of that take.
The 4K master is upscaled, not natively rendered at 4K.
